minutes.headline: Board approved all three alcohol renewals (4-1 on two) and began rewriting appointment and remote work policies.
minutes.summary: The Select Board interviewed and appointed three members to the 300th Anniversary Committee, ratified a new public access videographer, and waived first refusal on a Chapter 61 parcel. The town manager reported on the Lufa Farms project, grants and facilities. The workshop reviewed a remote work policy and the appointment policy line by line. The board then renewed alcohol, common victualler and miscellaneous licenses, with a split vote over a certificate of good standing and a past incident.

public_comment.topic: Remembered two former town beach staff, Cheryl Shaw and Genevieve Nass, including 35 years of lifeguarding and swim lessons by Ms Nass.

votes.motion: Appoint Mr Tyler, Mr Lincoln and Miss Johnson as the first three members of the 300th Anniversary Committee
Ratify the town manager's appointment of Matthew Monroe as Public Access videographer
Waive first refusal rights on 255 Sunny Hill Road parcel 3 under Chapter 61
Approve package store wine and malt license for Baker's Whalum variety, 423 Electric Ave
Approve restaurant all alcohol license for JK Waterfront Inc, On the Rocks, 96 Lakefront Drive
Approve restaurant all alcohol license for AAG LLC, Kindred Spirits, 324 Electric Ave number 4
Approve the common victualler license renewals as read by the chair
Approve the 2023 miscellaneous license renewals as read by the chair

budget_items.what_was_said: Total project cost and construction cost were estimated, with about 350 jobs. A tax increment financing agreement would need a vote at annual town meeting.
The fire chief received a grant for technical and dive rescue equipment.
The fire department was awarded a grant for hoses, nozzles and fittings.
Sprinkler repairs are needed and should be done soon.
An agreement was signed with Civic Plus to build a new website over six months.
The tax rate was reported as set.

budget_items.topic: Eagle House parking lot / ADA project
budget_items.what_was_said: The capital planning committee had questions about the cost of the parking lot request. The engineer was to recheck the estimate and a phased alternative.
The policy requires liability insurance per vehicle and workers compensation insurance on file.

decisions.decision: Remote work policy will return to the agenda next week after minor changes, including a workers compensation waiver where remote work is not mandated, a signed employee acknowledgment, and checking with counsel and the insurer.
Appointment policy: interviews required when there are multiple applicants or any new applicant; 'select board' to replace 'board' throughout; 'vacancies' replaces 'list of appointments'.
Appointment policy: reappointment and volunteer applications both due May 15th; the town manager forwards reappointment applications to the other body members for comment without a fixed date.
Wording on staff relationships in the appointed-officials guidance will be reworked with the town manager to go through the immediate supervisor and then the town manager's office.
Appointment policy likely to be approved next week.
Board will seek clarification on whether the limousine company is licensed in Fitchburg; license was already issued last week.
Board agreed to discuss later making the certificate of good standing an explicit licensing policy.
Town manager will work with the Parks Commissioners on a memorial or recognition for Ms Nass, such as a dedication at the town beach.
ARPA discussion moved to next week's meeting on Dec 20, the last of the calendar year.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted 4-1 to approve a package store license and a restaurant all-alcohol license; a second restaurant license passed unanimously.
Common victualler and 2023 miscellaneous license renewals passed unanimously, and the board agreed to discuss making a certificate of good standing an explicit licensing policy.
The board reviewed the remote work policy and the appointment policy line by line; the remote work policy returns next week after minor changes.
The board appointed three members to the new 300th Anniversary Committee and waived first refusal on a Chapter 61 parcel, both unanimously.
The town manager reported on the Lufa Farms project, whose tax increment financing agreement would need a vote at annual town meeting.

why_it_matters: A tax increment financing agreement for Lufa Farms would change how new tax revenue from the project is treated, and residents would be asked to vote on it at annual town meeting.
The remote work and appointment policies set how town staff and volunteer board members are chosen and employed, and the appointment policy is likely to be approved next week.
watch_next: The Select Board meeting on Dec 20, 2022, where the remote work policy returns, the appointment policy is likely to be approved, and the ARPA discussion is scheduled.
The annual town meeting vote on any Lufa Farms tax increment financing agreement.
